groundwater.title: National Compilation on Dynamic Ground Water Resources of India, 2024
groundwater.publisher: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), Ministry of Jal Shakti
groundwater.coverage: The report includes state-wise Annexure I and district-wise Annexure II. Bundled CSV contains only the national aggregates transcribed from the report summary; do not treat them as state-level figures.
groundwater.limitations: Groundwater resource recharge/extractable estimates are not groundwater-level observations.

flood.title: Bhuvan / NRSC Flood Services
flood.hazard_period: Historical maximum inundation layers from 1998–2019 used for hazard zonation
flood.annual_layers: Selected states and years; availability is not uniform nationally.
flood.aggregated_state_maps_period: 2003–2020 for selected states shown by Bhuvan.
flood.coverage_note: Use the Bhuvan portal to select available state/year layers. These are satellite-observed historical inundation/hazard products, not live flood alerts or a complete uniform 36-region dataset.
flood.limitations: Bhuvan warns that satellite swaths may miss peak flooding and flash/minor floods; observed inundation may also include embankment breaches or rainwater accumulation.

boundaries.title: India States and Union Territories GeoJSON
boundaries.coverage_note: The app first looks for a local file at static/portal/data/india_states.geojson and then tries the public GeoJSON source. This build does not contain a local polygon copy because the external asset could not be retrieved into the package in this environment. Verify boundary vintage and administrative naming before official/legal use.
